title: A Secret Agent Catches The Killer Of His Fiancee . . . And Does Something Cold . . . (highlight)
caption:
Daniel finally catches Victor, the man who murdered his fiancee, in I Saw the Devil (2010). Then he does something cold. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#isawthedevil #koreanmovie #movierecap #thriller #revenge

segments.say: A secret agent finds the man who *murdered* his fiancee. And what he does next is *cold*.
Victor is a school van driver. Tonight he has picked a new *girl*.
But he does not know that someone has been *following* him the whole time.
Daniel finally *finds* him, alone in a greenhouse.
Victor laughs. The cops found me this *quick*? You do not know who you are dealing with.
Daniel just stands there. Calm. No *rage*. That is what makes it scary.
Victor thinks he has the upper hand. That was his first *mistake*.
Victor is tough, but Daniel is *stronger*. The fight ends in seconds.
Daniel forces a small *capsule* into his mouth. And Victor has no choice but to *swallow* it.
It holds a GPS and a *microphone*. Now Daniel can follow him, and hear every *word*.
Then he just walks *away*. No police. No handcuffs.
Why would he let a killer go? Because a quick end is not what Daniel *wants*.
The full story is on our page.
